origin: third of the three routes the user asked to try. Instead of hand-designed rewards, take demonstrations from the official pretrained Flybody walking policy that already exists in this project and imitate them with the replacement policy on our body.

what_the_teacher_is.source: /run/media/sensen/Data2/cell_wound_prototype/experiments/flybody-teacher/20261107T174640Z (TensorFlow saved_model policies/walking, flybody.fly_envs.walk_imitation, 59 actuators), its own environment and its own body
what_the_teacher_is.label: official teacher = reference teacher, not our body, not our actuator, and not a connectome; its 59 actions include six adhere_claw channels and tarsus DOFs that our 42-joint body does not have

dropped: adhere_claw (our body has no such DOF and no adhesion geometry)
mapping_declared.unmapped_on_our_side: Trochanter_roll has no teacher counterpart; it is held at the solved stand pose value (declared constant, not a learned DOF)
mapping_declared.calibration: per joint a single additive offset chosen so the teacher's time-mean equals our solved stand pose value; joint signs are assumed identical and this assumption is recorded, not verified
mapping_declared.clipping: mapped targets are clipped into our joint ranges with a 0.01 rad margin

pipeline: teacher rollout 8 s at 500 Hz -> resample 200 Hz -> map+offset+clip to 42 targets -> supervised training of the same 294-128-128-42 base network (same recipe) -> evaluation open loop, then 64 PPO updates with the adhesion channel, gates unchanged
labelling: the result is a replacement ANN imitating a reference teacher; it is not the teacher's capability, not our body's validated walking, and not a connectome
accounting: teacher rollout time, number of samples kept after mapping and clipping, per-joint offset and clip fraction, base-network training MSE, and every evaluation metric including failures
